title: Extract fieldwork::nodeinfo module
description:
NodeInfo 2.0 discovery and document endpoints. ~50 lines, 98% identical across all three projects.

Source: BS server.rs:321-371, GJ discovery.rs, SH discovery.rs.

Public API:
- NodeInfoDiscovery struct — well-known/nodeinfo response with links to nodeinfo document
- NodeInfoDocument struct — full NodeInfo 2.0 response
- build_nodeinfo_discovery(domain: &str) -> NodeInfoDiscovery
- build_nodeinfo(domain: &str, software_name: &str, version: &str, user_count: i64, post_count: i64, open_registration: bool) -> NodeInfoDocument

What stays in consumers: DB queries for user_count/post_count, route registration, software name/version constants.

Deps: serde, serde_json. Optional: axum (for handler).
